text:
support-zoe: Hey team — Customer Noteable (acct: noteable-prod) hit a huge free-trial drop overnight, ~1.2M embedding tokens between 02:00-03:00 UTC. They run our bulk-vectorize background job. Can someone peek?
ryan-eng-sre: Looking now. Quick glance at worker logs shows tons of 202 Accepted responses from the embeddings service, followed by immediate requeue attempts from the sync client.
emma-ml: 202 should be treated as in-progress, not an error. If client treats 202 like 5xx it'll retry too aggressively. Do we have exponential backoff?
ryan-eng-sre: Not in this path — bulk-vectorize client has a bug: on 202 we set immediate_requeue=true and split batch into per-record requests, which multiplied traffic. Example log snippet:
```
bulk-vectorize request_id=abc123 batch_id=b-987 status=202
client: response=202 action=immediate_requeue split=true
worker: enqueue records=512 -> 512 single-item jobs
```
ingest-bot: webhook-callbacks: 02:10:05 GET /callbacks/vec/status?id=abc123 -> 504 gateway timeout (downstream slow)
ryan-eng-sre: So sequence was: embeddings returns 202, the downstream callback endpoint times out, client immediately splits+retries, each retry hits embeddings again — duplicates and token explosion.
maya-billing: Customer reports trial balance went from 10k -> negative very quickly. We already put a temporary hold but need to credit back and fix root cause.
jorge-cs: Noteable is upset. They've paused background jobs but want an explanation and reimbursement for trial credits consumed.
ryan-eng-sre: Repro steps I'm using locally: run bulk-vectorize with env DEBUG_RETRY=1 and set callback URL to a sink that returns 504. Commands:
```
export CALLBACK_URL=http://localhost:9090/slow
DEBUG_RETRY=1 go run cmd/bulk-vectorize --batch-size=512 --records 2048
```
You should see immediate split & retry behavior.
emma-ml: Short-term mitigations: 1) disable immediate split on 202 (patch candidate), 2) add 30s jittered wait before retrying 202, 3) ensure idempotency keys are per-record so duplicates dedupe at servant.
ryan-eng-sre: I'll open a hotfix PR to treat 202 as in-progress and add backoff. Also adding server-side dedupe on embedding requests keyed by record-id when present.
deploy-bot: new deploy queued ryan/202-backoff-fix -> staging at 2003456820 :rocket:
ryan-eng-sre: Pushed PR, rolling to staging now. Will monitor for fanout in logs.
maya-billing: I'll start manual refund for Noteable trial to restore 1.3M token-equivalent and add monitoring alert to catch similar spikes.
jorge-cs: Customer notified; offered credit and postmortem once root cause confirmed. They appreciated the quick update :thumbsup:
ryan-eng-sre: After staging tests, patch looks good — 202 now triggers wait+backoff and we avoid splitting immediately. Verified with the repro harness; no duplicate fanout.
emma-ml: Follow-ups: add explicit docs about 202 vs 5xx semantics for clients, add e2e test for callback slow path.
ryan-eng-sre: Postmortem draft started at https://redwood.internal/pm/postmortems/noteable-embed-spike (will attach logs).
maya-billing: Refund applied and customer closed escalations. Leaving alert on for 24h.
ryan-eng-sre: Marking this resolved for now. Will push postmortem + rollout to prod tomorrow morning (UTC). :white_check_mark:
